messages:
jordan-sales: Quick flag — Lighthouse (POC) needs the SIG done before kickoff at 3pm PT. Link to questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/qna/LI-POC-2026. Can someone own evidence collection?
jordan-sales: They specifically called out encryption at rest, KMS rotation, and internal pen-test results.
ajay-se: I'll take network + encryption. Need KMS rotation policy + CMK ARNs + where certs live.
tess-security: I can drop rotation policy and our latest pen-test summary into the evidence bucket. s3://redwood-sig-evidence/lighthouse-poc/ I'll upload now.
ops-bot: Reminder — SIG evidence upload due in 24h for thread 2350012345 :alarm_clock:
maria-ps: FYI billing will need approximate QPS for the POC to estimate pricing. Jordan — can you send expected traffic?
ajay-se: Jordan, also need the agent's service account name used by the POC so I can export role policies.
jordan-sales: sending expected QPS: ~50 concurrent, burst 200. Service account: lighthouse-poc-sa.
endrew-analytics: Quick note — for the pen-test summary use the shortened public report link: https://redwood.insights/reports/pen-2025-summary.pdf (no creds).
tess-security: Uploaded rotation_policy.pdf, pen-test-summary.pdf, and kms-arn-list.txt to s3://redwood-sig-evidence/lighthouse-poc/ (public link disabled).
ajay-se: grabbing them now. If anyone needs the exact command to download: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-sig-evidence/lighthouse-poc/ . --recursive --profile redwood-security
```

ajay-se: Able to attach the KMS rotation policy section to SIG Item 3.2.1 and certificate chain to Item 4.1.1 — will mark as 'evidence-attached' in the questionnaire.
jordan-sales: awesome. Tess, can you also confirm the SOC2 scope includes the infra region we're using? Customer specifically asked about EU residency.
tess-security: Confirmed — SOC2 scope includes us-east-1 and eu-west-1 (note: eu data residency covered under our contract annex). I'll add a short note in the evidence folder.
maria-ps: Thx team. I'll draft a one-pager for the customer summarizing answers and include estimated POC cost.
jordan-sales: appreciate it. Let me know if anything blocks you — aiming to close evidence loop by EOD. :thumbsup:
